intent: Fixed 24px swatch that previews a fill's paint — solid color, opacity, gradient, image, or video — always on the light inspector surface.

type: Opacity (left half solid, right half faded over checkerboard)
Gradient (host-projected authored gradient, falls back to color)
variant: Circle (16px filled circle; renders only when type is Fill)

tokens.note: No design tokens; Chit renders fixed light-surface colors by design (color swatches always sit on the light panel in UI3).

swatch.radius: note: rounded-[2px] hardcoded (14px square); Circle is rounded-full at 16px
swatch.size: note: outer size-[24px]; inner square 14px, circle 16px hardcoded

color.note: default #ff24bd hardcoded; paint supplied via color/gradient/previewUrl props (inline style, not a token)

a11y.note: Decorative: the bound Image renders empty alt + aria-hidden; the Video
